issues.description: The hook is empty, so when I see the episode in my podcast app, nothing tells me why I should press play.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a short hook such as: What were you doing when your friend called? / Bạn đang làm gì khi bạn của bạn gọi đến?

issues.description: Có phải cho bữa tiệc sinh nhật của mình không? is correct but sounds a little careful/formal for two friends.
issues.suggested_fix: Tuyệt! Cho bữa tiệc sinh nhật của mình à?

issues.description: The grammar note uses the label past continuous. At A2 I may remember the pattern better if the form is shown simply.
issues.suggested_fix: Use was/were + verb-ing for the longer action, and when + past simple for the shorter action: I was making a cake when you called.

issues.description: The gloss for cake is bánh ngọt, but in this birthday context the dialogue just says bánh. bánh ngọt can sound like a general pastry, not a birthday cake.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the Vietnamese gloss to bánh or bánh sinh nhật for this episode.

issues.description: The theme is a surprise birthday party, but the dialogue only says yes; there is no clear surprise moment.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the last line slightly more surprising, for example: Yes! Surprise! I have a big cake. / Ừ! Bất ngờ chưa! Mình có một cái bánh to.

qa_report.summary: The micro-dialogue is short, clear, and suitable for A2. The target grammar is easy to notice, and the Vietnamese lines are mostly natural. Small edits would make it more engaging and more natural: add a hook, make the grammar note simpler, adjust the cake gloss, and add a clearer surprise feeling.
